title: dryopteris affinis var. cristata
intro: Dryopteris affinis var. cristata, commonly known as the golden oak fern, is a variety of the fern species Dryopteris affinis, which is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. The golden oak fern is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm the nervous system, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the golden oak fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions.
